verdict.rationale: a-Shell stores user data as plain files (scripts, text) and supports iOS file-sharing/pickFolder to move files to other apps, which is inherently open-format since there's no proprietary database or lock-in — but there is no explicit 'export all my data' or backup/migration feature documented, and probes for machine-readable data/API docs (llms.txt, openapi) return 404s. missing for 10: an explicit bulk-export or backup command, documentation framing data portability as a first-class feature, and any machine-readable manifest of stored user data.
